name: Amsterdam City Hall
description: Amsterdam’s City Hall occupies the stepped administrative wing of the Stopera complex; the curved theatre is Dutch National Opera & Ballet.
identityNote: Distinct administrative function documented by municipality. This is an additional proposal, not a replacement or alias of the existing genuine Opera canonical destination. Official project location retained; route point must be snapped by normal route ingestion.

facts.text: The opera theatre opened in 1986; municipal staff moved into City Hall in 1988.
